articles.title: How AI and Simple Tech Can Save Nigerian Teachers Over 100 Hours Every Term
articles.author: Eesuola Joshua Damilare
articles.coverAlt: Modern educational technology saving teacher time
articles.summary: Grading exams and calculating student broadsheets by hand is exhausting. Here is how modern software and AI tools solve this problem easily.
articles.content:
Every term in Nigeria, teachers face the same heavy task: adding continuous assessment scores, calculating subject positions, working out class averages, and writing remarks on hundreds of paper report cards.

When teachers spend all their free time doing manual arithmetic, they have little energy left to prepare inspiring lessons.

### Why DLM ResultDesk Changes Everything
We built DLM ResultDesk specifically for how Nigerian schools operate:
1. **Enter Scores Once**: Teachers simply type in continuous assessment (CA) and exam marks.
2. **Automatic Calculations**: The computer calculates totals, percentages, grade letters (A1 to F9), and class positions instantly.
3. **Print Ready Report Cards**: Clean, professional report cards with school crests and signatures are generated with one click.
4. **Works Offline**: You do not need internet or data subscription to compute grades.

articles.title: Setting Up a Reliable Computer Lab in a Nigerian School: What Principals Need to Know
articles.author: DLM Technical Team
articles.coverAlt: School computer laboratory with durable desktop stations
articles.summary: A straightforward guide to choosing durable computers, setting up local networks, and planning reliable power backup for school CBT centers.
articles.content:
Many Nigerian school owners want to set up modern computer laboratories, but fear wasting money on fragile systems or dealing with frequent power cuts.

At Divine Leads Media, we supply and install school technology equipment with three key rules:
1. **Durable Business-Grade Hardware**: We recommend refurbished and new desktop computers designed to handle heavy student use and dusty environments.
2. **Clean Power Inverters**: Connecting school systems to an inverter with solar backup prevents sudden shutdowns that damage hard drives during power cuts.
3. **Local Offline Networking**: Setting up a local server allows an entire lab of 30 to 100 computers to run CBT practice tests smoothly without depending on internet connections.

articles.title: Teaching Nigerian Students How to Use AI as a Study Partner, Not a Shortcut
articles.author: Eesuola Joshua Damilare
articles.coverAlt: Students collaborating with digital AI learning tools
articles.summary: Artificial Intelligence is already here. Here is how we teach secondary school learners to use AI to understand difficult subjects and build real skills.
articles.content:
Artificial intelligence is changing how the world works. In Nigeria, our students should not just be passive consumers of foreign technology; they need to understand how to use digital tools and AI to learn faster.

In our workshops, we guide students on:
- Using AI to explain complicated science and math topics in simple words.
- Checking facts and verifying sources so they do not copy incorrect answers.
- Learning computational thinking and logic to solve everyday problems.
